input.sha256_scope: No image input beyond a zero-filled shape. Every case is synthetic layout, region, span, and table-html specs written out in the capture tool; the expected file is both the input record and the expected record.

reference_paths: paddlex 3.7.2: inference/pipelines/layout_parsing/pipeline_v2.py standardized_data, get_layout_parsing_objects, sort_layout_parsing_blocks, get_layout_parsing_res (order_index tail)
upstream.capture_method: The pinned post-model chain was executed unbound over six synthetic scenarios: standardized_data into get_layout_parsing_objects into sort_layout_parsing_blocks into the order_index numbering with the pipeline's default markdown_ignore_labels. The same shape-keyed stub recognizer as the standardized-data capture stands in for the text model (never reached by text-labelled spans in the assembly stage; its call log is recorded). Scenarios cover table pred_html injection and its image-path stamp, the formula-label OCR re-matching, the vision_footnote relabel skipping order_index, masked labels ordered but unnumbered, two detected regions flattening in nested order, and a table block with no table results.

limitations: Seal and chart result lists are empty by construction: those recognizers are off in this port's supported mode, so their content branches are dead code upstream too.
The recognizer is the shape-keyed stub shared with classic-v1-standardized-data; real models join in the end-to-end slice.
block.image records only the path here; the actual pixel crop is an API-level concern outside this fixture.
